context_for_next_testing_agent: Issue iter93dt-clear-nego fully resolved. PUT with negotiated_flat_fee=null correctly triggers $unset and pricing_mode falls back to 'tranches' with tiered amount computed. Verified both via test (test_clear_negotiated_fallback_to_tiers) and direct DB inspection (field absent from document).
rca of the issue: Previous implementation relied on model_dump(exclude_none=True) which dropped null values, so sending {negotiated_flat_fee: null} was silently ignored. Fix uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so explicitly-provided nulls survive, then splits payload into $set (non-None) and $unset (None). Result: clients can now clear a negotiated fee via null and the syndic reverts to tiered pricing.
